name: Avatares AI - Get Canonical Asset - Callable

parameters.query:
SELECT
  asset_id,
  avatar,
  asset_type,
  scene,
  version,
  bucket,
  object_path,
  original_filename,
  mime_type,
  file_size,
  extension,
  sha256,
  status,
  is_canonical,
  canonical_group,
  metadata,
  created_at
FROM canonical_asset_registry
WHERE avatar = '{{ $json.avatar }}'
  AND scene = '{{ $json.scene }}'
  AND asset_type = '{{ $json.assetType }}'
  AND status = 'canonical'
  AND is_canonical = true
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
